captures.what_is_new: The provisions as the text shows them: a 'small mid-cap enterprise' (SMC) defined by reference to Recommendation (EU) 2025/1099; the AI literacy obligation does not require any guaranteed level of literacy of any individual, and the Commission and Member States shall support providers and deployers, in particular SMEs; providers of such systems may exceptionally process special categories of personal data for bias detection and correction under conditions (no other data suffices, not transmitted or accessed by others, deleted once the bias is corrected or retention ends); for SMCs each fine is up to the lower of the percentages or amount; the AI Office exclusively competent for certain systems based on general-purpose models; at least one national sandbox operational by 2 August 2027; dates of 2 December 2026 and 2 December 2027 / 2 August 2028. Only the named provisions were read; the page's recitals and other provisions were not.

A law firm's summary of the published regulation: published 24 July, in force three days later; the privileges for small businesses extended to small mid-caps (simplified technical documents, a proportionate management system, proportionality in fines); the AI literacy duty kept in revised form; a new Article 4a on special categories of data for bias; the AI Office's exclusive competence; sandboxes postponed. The firm's reading.
Already in S78; context on the provisional agreement of 7 May.

story_candidates.title: AI literacy, bias data and small firms: the AI Act changes

ai_path.connection: Direct: the text of the regulation that amends the EU's AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744).
ai_path.places: The European Union and its Member States.

story_candidates.angle: A follow-up article to S77 (which cannot take another note today): what the amended AI Act's text says on five points that matter to smaller companies. The AI literacy duty stays but does not require anyone to reach a guaranteed level, and the Commission and Member States must support providers and deployers, in particular small and medium-sized firms. Providers may exceptionally process sensitive categories of personal data to detect and correct bias, under three conditions. For small mid-caps a fine is capped at the lower of the two amounts. The AI Office gets exclusive supervision of certain systems built on general-purpose models. Member States must have at least one national sandbox running by 2 August 2027.
